title: USF Source Reference Schema
description: Draft JSON Schema for references to historical (../react) and current source evidence (rank-6 historical-source-evidence). Each reference declares the repository, a resolvable path and/or commit/tag, a source kind (source-kinds), a source role (source-roles), and a disposition (disposition-values), so lineage is traceable and source paths never become USF target architecture. Governs the ontology concepts Source Reference and Evidence. Historical forbidden tokens (v2, legacy, ...) are permitted inside the path field because it is quoted historical evidence. Reference resolution is validator-deferred per schema-authoring-standard §24. lifecycleState draft; not active.

repository.$comment: Originating repository, e.g. '../react' / 'maldous/react'. Marked external so historical paths are not mistaken for USF targets.

path.$comment: Verbatim historical path; MAY contain historical forbidden tokens because it is quoted evidence, never a USF target path.
